mechanism: DSA -> endothelial engagement -> FCGR3A-positive innate effectors -> cytotoxic/IFNG response -> microvascular injury -> persistence or response

nk_identity.interpretation: coherent NK-lineage program; KIR genes alone are insufficient

fcgr3a_adcc_effector.interpretation: Fc-receptor signaling capacity; requires NK-versus-monocyte cell localization

cytotoxicity.interpretation: cytotoxic effector state; not NK-specific without cell localization

negative_control_t_cell.interpretation: detect T-cell admixture and prevent KIR-positive CD8 cells being called NK cells

negative_control_monocyte.interpretation: distinguish FCGR3A-positive monocytes from FCGR3A-positive NK cells

endothelial_identity.interpretation: endothelial abundance/identity reference; not itself evidence of injury

endothelial_activation_injury.interpretation: activated microvascular endothelial state; interpret relative to endothelial identity

tissue_injury_repair.interpretation: injury/repair response; not specific to alloimmune injury
